rules: Full source precision for explicit selected-mode RPM and burst timing. Implicit defaults retain legacy cadence for unchanged output.
Bolt/pump single records retain source RPM but the simulator uses existing cycle cadence.
Burst Training gates WB burst alternates. GRT-CPS source-only burst is excluded.
L63 hip no-bloom applies only after manual single selection on bound rows; default VSSM bloom and Match Trigger behavior remain unchanged.
Unavailable selections return to the current loadout default; mode-changing attachments can replace the base default.
VSSM Folding Stock single override is 399.9989929199219 RPM; negative source slots do not replace positive base rates.
